market_story: CT_CHP: CAISO's CT_CHP class is the Kern County EOR steam-flood, refinery, and campus/hospital cogen fleet — steam-host obligations run the turbines as high-loading baseload whenever the host operates (measured >=70% loading in 79/85/88% of on-capacity-hours, 2023/24/25), and most of the fleet sits below the Part 75 CEMS threshold so its grid delivery appears only in EIA-923; the steam floor carries that measured delivered baseload times the sector grid-delivery share, which is why the class delivers ~1.5-2 TWh/yr independent of the merit order. CC_CHP: the flat merchant steam hosts (Los Medanos, Elk Hills) hold their measured loading-when-on baseload around the clock, while partial cyclers (Gilroy, King City) carry only their on-frequency-collapsed delivered level. Storage: the battery fleet dispatches inside the measured EIA-930 NG:OTH p95 diurnal envelope (caiso-99 anchor, carried).
